verdict.rationale: Attio's data model clearly supports custom objects/attributes (attio-docs-8, attio-docs-46, attio-docs-66, attio-docs-84) and filtering/sorting is documented at the API level (attio-docs-6, attio-docs-27, attio-docs-31, attio-docs-79) with 'private lists' mentioned in pricing (attio-docs-83) implying list/view sharing controls exist. However, evidence never explicitly confirms an ops user (non-admin) can create/share views or add fields without admin permissions—only that certain standard objects like Deals require admin activation (attio-docs-13, attio-docs-33), leaving the permission boundary for custom-field/view creation unconfirmed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of view creation/sharing UI workflow, and confirmation that ops-level (non-admin) users can add custom fields without elevated permissions.
